''For his original Kabam game stats, see [[Soundblaster/Tactician]].''

'''Soundblaster''' is now a Demolitions Decepticon.

==Bio==
''This arms dealer keeps his enemies under careful observation, along with his loyal ally Buzzsaw. With his strong connections all over Cybertron and eyes in the sky, Soundblaster keeps a close eye on everyone.''

==Story==

==Game Abilities==

===Basic Abilities===
*Special Damage
*Critical Damage
===Abilities===

* Passive:
** [[File:Buff Special Damage.png|20x20px]] Soundblaster Gains a Special Damage Buff every 5 seconds, increasing Special Damage by 17.4~27 %. (Max: 6 stacks).
** [[File:Buff Crit Damage.png|20x20px]] Once Soundblaster finishes generating Special Damage Buffs, he begins generating a Critical Damage Buff every 3 seconds, each adding 13.8~18.9% Critical Damage. (Max: 6 Stacks)
** These Buffs are removed after Soundblaster successfully lands the last hit of a Special Attack.
* All Attacks
** [[File:Buff Crit Rate.png|21x21px]] +50% Critical Rate if the opponent is under the effect of a Debuff.
*''Ranged Attacks''
**30% chance to instantly inflict a 20% Resistance Debuff for 5 seconds.
*''Heavy Attack''
**Buzzsaw fires 3 shots that track the opponent.

==Audio Files==
The exact same as [[Soundwave]]'s.

==Trivia==

* Soundblaster is ''not'' a redeco of Soundwave, but a new or heavily modified model based on the ''Masterpiece'' Soundblaster toy.
* Soundblaster is a separate entity from Soundwave, as with the recent trend of the character, as well the fact there has never been multiple Bots that represent the same character in the game.
* The Netflix version of Soundblaster has his Combo Meter skillset replaced with [[Mixmaster]]'s Special Buff generation.
* The Buzzsaw Heavy Attack properly works - all three shots hit in succession and then knockdown.
